scale: common within-screen-centered population SD of unique NTC cells

definition_sensitivity.individual_method: All metrics use the named method in run_state; four specialist methods have one frozen evaluation output shared by both state labels.
definition_sensitivity.coherent_median_ensemble: Element-wise median across ten same-state method responses within fold and gene-screen-endpoint; all metrics use that predictor. Recovery: endpoint-macro Pearson then mean of five folds. Fidelity: equal-screen mean per gene, then magnitudes across 1,000 genes.
definition_sensitivity.state_matched_hybrid: Recovery is the median of ten same-state method recovery scores; fidelity is computed from the same-state profile-median ensemble before screen averaging. Definition sensitivity, not a unified predictor.
definition_sensitivity.hybrid_median_before_screen_mean: Historical mixed-state construction: recovery is the median of legacy single-state method scores; fidelity uses run_state profile medians before screen averaging. The checkpoint_average row replays the pre-revision historical ledger; it is not the adopted reference.

reference_semantics: Every changes_vs_reference and delta field in this package uses checkpoint_average coherent_median_ensemble, including single-state sensitivity rows.
